card.name: Page numbers in journal citations
card.fires_on: The colon, space or "pp" that comes just before the page numbers in a journal reference, after the year, volume or issue. It also fires on a space before a number in a statistic.

modes.label: Citation page slot
modes.description: The punctuation or marker right before the page range in a reference list entry.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space just before a number, in a citation or in a percentage comparison.

card.writes: It pushes toward web-topic words like blogs and wiki and away from Cold War terms, which is not a clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a journal reference where the page numbers come next.
